integrity.scientific_claim: globally unique minimum Bayes risk for a single noisy observation of integrated quadratic OU path energy, with monotone optimal time in noise

scientific_limitations: One deterministic scalar state observation of zero-start Ornstein–Uhlenbeck dynamics; not a multi-sensor or adaptive statement.
Known positive damping, unit diffusion, unit time horizon and independent Gaussian measurement noise of time-independent known variance.
Historical novelty remains to be independently assessed; asymptotic and finite-grid checks do not replace the analytic global proof.
title: Unique noise-calibrated sensing time for Ornstein–Uhlenbeck quadratic energy
